Name: Harvey's Less Ugly House
Author: 0Renciel
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=5][u][b][i]Harvey's Less Ugly House[/i][/b]

[/u][/size][size=3]A very simple mod with a fairly short description.[/size]

[size=3]One of my eyes is asleep while typing this out, sorry to disappoint but no Harvey slander for now.
(Check my other mod for plenty of that tho :p)

DO NOT SIT ON THE  COUCH FACING RIGHT. 
See pictures for preview. Yes, I flipped the couch and the game doesn't like it. There isn't a red couch that faces to the right in the tilesheets I used so I make do.

[i][u][color=#ea9999][b][size=5]NEW!! 1.0.4[/size]

[/b][/color][/u][/i][list]
[*][size=3]Added [u][color=#a4c2f4][b]Compatibility[/b][/color][/u] version - This is good for those who has a mod that adds any cutscenes inside his room. Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM![/url][/size]
[*]Added a new dependency, now needs EML or EML for Android if you're on mobile!
[/list][size=3][u]
[color=#ea9999][b]No, it still won't work with SVE.[/b][/color][/u][/size]

This has the most simplest coding that is known to man, so though I dread it I know there will be bugs and whatnot that I have overlooked. If you've spotted one, feel free to send a bug report [/size][u]AFTER[/u][size=3] reading below. Bug reports from those who has clearly not read the mod description will be ignored and/or deleted![/size]

[size=4][i]Enjoy![/i][/size]


[size=5][u][b][i][color=#ff0000]Very Important, Read me![/color][/i][/b]

[/u]What this mod [i][b][u][color=#ff0000]DOESN'T[/color][/u] [/b][/i]do:[/size]
[s]
[size=4][b]1. Add a night time version[/b][/size][/s][size=3]
[/size] 
[size=3]Learned how to do that, no more eternal sunlight :(([/size]

[size=4][s][b]2. Edits the Heart events[/b]
[/s][/size][size=3][s]
I made this mod with the VANILLA heart events in mind. So in theory, it should work fine without any mods that expands on Harvey's story, changes it's interiors, or adds any cutscenes inside his home.

[/s]It's fine, if you have any clipping issues use the [b][u][color=#a4c2f4]Compatibility[/color][/u][/b] version instead.

[/size][size=4][b]3. Gives Harvey better eyesight[/b][/size]

[size=3]Trust me, if I knew how to do that I'd do it to myself too.[/size]


[size=5][u][b][i]Compatibilities[/i][/b][/u][/size]

[u][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]East Scarp[/b][/size][/color][/u][size=4], [/size][size=3]if it adds a cutscene inside his home, you might experience some clipping issues. Otherwise should be okay![/size]
[u][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]RidgeSide Village[/b][/size][/color][/u][size=4], [/size][size=3]read above :)[/size]
[u][color=#ff0000][size=4][b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b][/size][/color][/u][size=4], [/size][size=3]updated, no It is not compatible.[/size]
[color=#00ff00][b][u]Harvey [/u][/b][b][u]Expansions[/u][/b][/color][size=4], [/size][size=3][color=#f4f4f4]should be alright if you use the [/color][b][u][color=#a4c2f4]Compatibility[/color][/u][/b][color=#f4f4f4] version.[/color][/size]

[b]Regarding SVE, [/b][size=3]that's a flat [u][b][color=#ff0000]no[/color][/b][/u] chief, are you honestly surprised? :p[/size]

[u][size=5][b][i]Installation[/i][/b]

[/size][/u][size=3]1. Install Content Patcher and Extra Map Layers (EML for Android if you're on mobile!)
2. Download this mod
3. Extract the zip into your mods folder 
4. Viola![/size][/font]
